T014 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
      (∀ (s δ : ℝ),
          0 < s →
            0 < δ →
              ∃ k U,
                E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) ∧ ∑ i, Metric.ediam (U i) ^ s < ∞) ∧
        (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → Hscale s δ E < ∞) ∧
          0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞ ∧ (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ dimH E = 0) →
    (∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH E → ENNReal.ofReal (s + 1) ≤ dimH (cyl n E)) →
      0 < dimH E → dimH E + 1 ≤ dimH (cyl n E)
'Translation.T014' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
